title: A new multi-purpose FRET fluorescent probe for the simultaneous detection of proteases
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34821-34832
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03163J, Paper
Open Access

Petra Jedináková, Zuzana Barbuščáková, David Milićević, Martin Kubala, Jan Hlaváč
A new methodology for the detection of three model proteases using a multi-purpose peptide probe equipped with three selectively cleavable sites and four fluorophores was developed and studied.
